items.title: Send these readings to your care team today
items.text: Your average blood sugar was 211.5 mg/dL, which is higher than the target. Contact your care team today to discuss your readings.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in blood sugar. Walking for 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain, with a rise 17.5 mg/dL less.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Only 16.7% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which is good. Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners across the program.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 8.2 hours, which is shorter than some other periods. Adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone in the program.
